import contextlib, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, runpy, signal, sys, unittest
method = "test_artifact_valid_and_rejection_matrix"
out = {"schema": 1, "target": "local-sdk-semantic-v1", "methods": [method], "result": "failed", "tests": 0, "failures": 0, "errors": 1, "skipped": 0, "fixture_cleanup": "unknown"}
def timeout(signum, frame):
    raise TimeoutError()
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, timeout)
signal.alarm(10)
try:
    expected = {"docs/planning/poc/client-framework/native-lab/build.py": "8f230e9a9d7f45f42a16e4be57f42a685c7eee1d7f7f06e3aa3651c605f6cc1f", "docs/planning/poc/client-framework/native-lab/Tests/test_build.py": "cbc114e5e526881ddac1d60c11684998998a8c2ef8a31b2221e09533f9d4757a", "docs/planning/poc/client-framework/native-build-contract.md": "9c3f3a37366927008b23dcfcff6ecccbeb39d811261de768857ca38ababbb13c"}
    for path, digest in expected.items():
        if hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
        module = runpy.run_path("docs/planning/poc/client-framework/native-lab/Tests/test_build.py", run_name="artifact_predicate_target")

        unittest.TestSuite([module["BuildTests"](method)]).run(result)

    out.update(result="passed" if passed else "failed", tests=result.testsRun, failures=len(result.failures), errors=len(result.errors), skipped=len(result.skipped), fixture_cleanup="passed" if passed else "unknown")
except (Exception, KeyboardInterrupt):
    pass
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
encoded = json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))

    out["result"] = "failed"
print(encoded)
sys.exit(0 if out["result"] == "passed" else 1)
